# DataPingo

> DataPingo builds apps that fix the everyday frustrations in the Atlassian ecosystem — each one solving a single problem in Confluence or Jira, completely.

DataPingo's apps run natively inside Confluence Cloud and Jira Cloud on Atlassian Forge, with no external server in the path. Each is free for teams of 10 users or fewer and sold through the Atlassian Marketplace.

## Products

- [Bulk Comments for Jira](https://datapingo.com/products/bulk-comments): Comment on up to 25 Jira issues from one page, with a different comment (and, if needed, a status change) on each — or write one comment and copy it to the rest. Images, video and files up to 150 MB each are included. Works with Jira, Jira Service Management (JSM), Customer Service Management and Jira Product Discovery; on a JSM request each comment is a reply to the customer, an internal note, or both. Free for teams up to 10 users. Marketplace: https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/2184917707/bulk-comments-for-jira
- [Bulk Page Cloner for Confluence](https://datapingo.com/products/bulk-page-cloner): Clone one Confluence page into up to 25 copies in a single run — content, formatting, images, video, macros, labels and attachments all carried over. Name every copy first, then place them under a parent you pick, at the space root, or under a new parent, in any space you can reach. Free for teams up to 10 users. Marketplace: https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/2754913942/bulk-page-cloner-for-confluence

## How-to

- [How to clone a Confluence page into multiple copies](https://datapingo.com/resources/blog/bulk-copy-confluence-pages-guide): Why Confluence's own Copy makes one copy at a time, and the four-step flow that clones one page into up to 25 named copies with formatting, labels and attachments intact.
- [Copy one comment across the batch](https://datapingo.com/resources/documentation/bulkcomments/guide/step-2-write-comments#copying): Post the same comment to every Jira issue in a batch, then reword the ones that need it.
- [Reply to multiple Jira Service Management requests at once](https://datapingo.com/resources/documentation/bulkcomments/guide/service-management): Customer replies, internal notes, or both, across up to 25 requests in one send.
- [Incident and release updates in Jira](https://datapingo.com/resources/use-cases/incident-and-release-updates): Updating every affected issue after an incident or release, in one pass.
- [Recurring Confluence pages](https://datapingo.com/resources/use-cases/recurring-confluence-pages): Cloning a monthly report, sprint retro or onboarding page for the periods ahead in one run.

## Documentation

- [Documentation](https://datapingo.com/resources/documentation): Setup guides, limits and error fixes for both apps.
- [Bulk Comments for Jira — Documentation](https://datapingo.com/resources/documentation/bulkcomments): Installation, the three-step guide (select issues, write a comment on each, send the batch), the comment editor, Jira Service Management requests, limits, FAQ and release notes.
- [Bulk Comments for Jira — FAQ](https://datapingo.com/resources/documentation/bulkcomments/faq): Setup, which Jira products it works with, limits, attachments, undo, pricing and where your data goes.
- [Bulk Comments for Jira — Limits](https://datapingo.com/resources/documentation/bulkcomments/limits): 25 issues per send, 150 MB per file, and the 2 GB per-send ceiling.
- [Bulk Comments for Jira — Specs, Permissions & Security](https://datapingo.com/resources/documentation/bulkcomments/specs): Permissions requested, data handling and the Forge security model.
- [Bulk Comments for Jira — Release notes](https://datapingo.com/resources/documentation/bulkcomments/release-notes): What changed in each version.
- [Bulk Page Cloner for Confluence — Documentation](https://datapingo.com/resources/documentation/bulkpagecloner): Installation, the four-step guide (source, copies, location, done), limits, FAQ and release notes.
- [Bulk Page Cloner for Confluence — FAQ](https://datapingo.com/resources/documentation/bulkpagecloner/faq): Setup, permissions, what gets copied, @mention notifications, storage, pricing and data handling.
- [Bulk Page Cloner for Confluence — Limits](https://datapingo.com/resources/documentation/bulkpagecloner/limits): 25 copies of one source page per run, and how copies count toward Confluence storage.
- [Bulk Page Cloner for Confluence — Specs, Permissions & Security](https://datapingo.com/resources/documentation/bulkpagecloner/specs): Permissions requested, data handling and the Forge security model.
- [Bulk Page Cloner for Confluence — Release notes](https://datapingo.com/resources/documentation/bulkpagecloner/release-notes): What changed in each version.
